@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+---
+id: 20260420141000
+aliases: ["publish antora docs", "github pages docs publishing"]
+tags: [docs, antora, github-pages]
+target: backlog
+---
+
+Publish the curated Antora docs site from `docs/` to GitHub Pages so the
+canonical documentation is available as a public website without requiring
+local site builds.
+
+This should follow Antora's recommended GitHub Pages workflow and keep the
+published site aligned with the Antora component under `docs/modules/ROOT`.
+
+## Links
+
+- [[Antora and AsciiDoctor Adoption Boundary]]
+- `docs/antora.yml`
+- `docs/modules/ROOT/pages/index.adoc`
+- https://docs.antora.org/antora/latest/publish-to-github-pages/
